name: identified_replay
query: did the staged rollout reduce synthetic rollbacks
note: A second complete analysis in a different domain: randomised staged rollout, declared confounder set, named estimand, two robustness checks, and a replayable result pointer. The gate must accept it.

attempt.title: The synthetic staged rollout reduced synthetic rollbacks
attempt.body: Synthetic rollout experiment (generated, not observed people). Teams were randomised to staged or immediate rollout. The rollback count after 30 days is lower in the staged arm. Identification assumptions are stated and tested; the dataset and the batch result are the recorded sources.

causal_record.temporal_order: rollout arm assigned before the rollback window

retrieval.title: Synthetic staged rollout and rollbacks
retrieval.body: Synthetic randomised rollout: staged teams saw fewer rollbacks than immediate teams. Identification assumptions are stated and tested against the generated dataset and the recorded batch result.
